प्रदक्षिणा

WALK AROUND HIM

You meet a mandir by walking around it, keeping it to your right. So the page does the same: the passage below moves only clockwise — east, south, west, north — and ends at the threshold.

गर्भगृह
The walk ends where He sits. A photograph will stand here after prāṇa-pratiṣṭhā — until then, the heart-lotus holds the place.

गर्भगृह में
WHAT THE SANCTUM WILL HOLD

The Shivling of Rtambhareshvara, standing on its Jaladhari — the basin that gathers the abhiṣeka waters and lets them out north through the nālī. The actual thing this whole site walks toward. Its one mark carries three readings; they open past this door.

गर्भगृह
GO BEFORE HIM
